mapper.sql: id, name, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_activity ( name, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{name}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select from seckill_activity where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select from seckill_activity where status = 2 and end_time > now() and is_deleted = 0 order by start_time, id
select from seckill_activity where ( status = 3 or (status in (1, 2) and end_time <= now()) ) and is_deleted = 0 order by end_time, id limit 100
mapper.update: update seckill_activity set name = #{name}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
